theater_main_quest_04_01_05_026:
I'm sensing some indescribable, sickly-sweet
aura closing in on Bell...
theater_main_quest_04_01_05_029: Mm. Now, drink up, drink up.
theater_main_quest_04_01_05_030:
Phew... Thanks again for helping out with the
expedition, Take, Miach, Hephaistos.
theater_main_quest_04_01_05_031:
No thanks are needed, Hestia.
We are good neighbors, are we not?
theater_main_quest_04_01_05_032:
Yeah. My familia's bound to need your help
someday too. We're even.
theater_main_quest_04_01_05_033:
Like you asked, I'll send some of my smiths
to keep an eye on your home.
theater_main_quest_04_01_05_034:
The moment I said they'd get to see Welf's
workshop, I was swamped with volunteers!
theater_main_quest_04_01_05_035:
That's a huge help. If I had to mind the house
alone, I couldn't go to my part-time job.
theater_main_quest_04_01_05_036:
Honestly, lending people out just so you can
pay back your debt? It's hardly worth it.
theater_main_quest_04_01_05_039:
Still, leaving all the preparations to our
children while we gods sit here drinking—
theater_main_quest_04_01_05_041:
Well, what can I do?!
Bell and the others take care of everything!
theater_main_quest_04_01_05_042: There's nothing for me to do at home, y'know?
theater_main_quest_04_01_05_043:
Hah hah... True enough. Ouka, Chigusa,
and Mikoto too, of course—
they've all grown strong.
theater_main_quest_04_01_05_044: Left me covered in nasty bruises.
theater_main_quest_04_01_05_046:
Nahza's skill at mixing medicines
has improved even further, too.
theater_main_quest_04_01_05_047:
She was determined to make a new remedy
for Bell before the expedition.
theater_main_quest_04_01_05_048:
...Everyone keeps growing up, huh?
They don't need looking after anymore...
theater_main_quest_04_01_05_049:
What's this, Hestia?
Don't tell me you're lonely?
theater_main_quest_04_01_05_050:
Of course I'm lonely!!
I can't go into the Dungeon with them!!
theater_main_quest_04_01_05_051: How could I not be lonely...?
theater_main_quest_04_01_05_052:
But you're just as proud of them,
aren't you?
theater_main_quest_04_01_05_054: I'm happy, or proud, or whatever you call it!
theater_main_quest_04_01_05_055: It makes my chest go all tight!
theater_main_quest_04_01_05_056:
Bell used to be such a crybaby, and now he's
so cool, so gallant, so confident!
theater_main_quest_04_01_05_057:
Geez, I'm falling for him all over again!
My heart's going pitter-pat!
theater_main_quest_04_01_05_058:
Nwaaah! I won't hand him over!
I'm never giving Bell to anyone!!
theater_main_quest_04_01_05_060:
Honestly, I do have my worries about the
expedition. They're going there to grow.
theater_main_quest_04_01_05_061:
I'm the one who invited all your children
along, but... there are risks.
theater_main_quest_04_01_05_064:
Bell and the others...
I know they'll pull through.
theater_main_quest_04_01_05_066:
Indeed.
They shall see it through.
theater_main_quest_04_01_05_069:
All right, then!
To the success of our children's adventure—
theater_main_quest_04_01_06_002:
Mr. Welf says to please
wait just a little longer!
theater_main_quest_04_01_06_003: Honestly... I told him to be on time.
theater_main_quest_04_01_06_004: What about Miss Daphne and Miss Cassandra?
theater_main_quest_04_01_06_005:
Sorry. Those two were arguing all morning,
so I came on ahead.
theater_main_quest_04_01_06_006: They ought to arrive shortly, I believe...
theater_main_quest_04_01_06_008:
Good grief.
What a start to the expedition.
theater_main_quest_04_01_06_009:
I figured I'd be the last one here.
Guess I hurried for nothing.
theater_main_quest_04_01_06_014:
You won't believe this! This morning,
she suddenly says she doesn't want to go!
theater_main_quest_04_01_06_015:
W-well, you see...
I had another prophetic dream...
theater_main_quest_04_01_06_016:
Disgusting green moss was
swallowing up lots of people!
theater_main_quest_04_01_06_018:
Could we call off the expedition...
or maybe postpone it...?
theater_main_quest_04_01_06_019:
Um... I'm sorry.
That's really not something we can do...
theater_main_quest_04_01_06_023:
Look, past the middle floors, trouble's
a given. Getting through it is the
adventure, right?
theater_main_quest_04_01_06_027: So this is what I ordered.
theater_main_quest_04_01_06_028: Yep. Earn back the cost on this expedition.
theater_main_quest_04_01_06_032:
A new weapon made from the unicorn's horn...
Hakugen.
theater_main_quest_04_01_06_035:
I worked on it down to the wire, so I'm
confident in how it turned out. Put it to use.
theater_main_quest_04_01_06_038: Leave the home to us and go wild!
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_084:
This is your first Divine Moon Festival,
isn't it, you two?
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_086:
Yes. It's a festival that's been held since
before the gods descended.
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_087:
If I remember right, they liken the moon to
a god and pray for safety from monsters?
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_088: Another piece of mortal-world culture, huh?
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_089:
With all the adventurers here,
it's very Orario.
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_106: Step right up, step right up!!
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_108: Hear me from afar, and behold me up close—
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_110:
Adventurers confident in your skill, step up!
Who's the hero who'll pull this spear?!
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_112:
Only the chosen can pull this legendary spear!
Its wielder is promised the blessing
of a chaste goddess!
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_113:
And! The one who pulls it wins a deluxe
world tour!! The Guild's already approved it!!
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_116: Lord Hermes is running another shady event...
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_117: But it looks fun! Let's give it a shot, Bell!
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_119: Let's give it a try too—
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_127: Ms. Ais, we can't lose this one!!
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_129:
Bell! The honor of our Familia
is riding on this!!
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_130:
Um, I really don't think
it's that kind of thing...
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_137: ...No good... It won't budge an inch...
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_138: Oh my, Lefiya! That was fast—way too fast!
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_141:
Well, well, what have we here—
it's the Sword Princess, Ais Wallenstein!
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_146: And Ais Wallenstein puts her back into it!!
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_149: No good... It won't come out...
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_150: No way! Not even Ms. Ais at Level 6...
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_151: All right! Bell, show that Valen-whatsit!!
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_153: Eh, just have fun with it!
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_154: A-as if a Level 2 like you could pull it out.
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_158: Yes! I'll give it my best!
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_159: And here comes the Little Rookie!
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_170: Heh heh, did you see that?
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_174: Oh, um, I don't really get it either...
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_175:
Heh... Now, let's bring out
the sponsor of this trip!
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_181:
She's my close friend from the heavens!
My bestie!!
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_193: What was that just now, Artemis?!
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_194: I'm sorry... I was just so happy...
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_196: G-Goddess... We've never met before, right?
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_201:
That's supposed to be Artemis?!
Something's wrong here!
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_202:
Well, maybe Artemis has gotten
a taste of mortal life too.
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_204: What was Lady Artemis like originally?
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_205:
Artemis is one of the virgin goddesses
of the heavens. She presides over chastity.
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_206:
Basically, she's the chairwoman of the
anti-romance committee. She hates love.
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_208: So how did she end up like THIS?!
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_209:
But why would a goddess who hates romance
be a sponsor?
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_210:
The truth is, a monster's appeared
outside Orario.
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_212:
Yes. The Artemis Familia found it, but it's a
tricky foe. So they asked Orario for help—
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_213: So the "world tour" is just a front—
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_214:
And it's actually a quest from Lady Artemis
to exterminate a monster, is that it?
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_216: I knew it sounded too good to be true!
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_220:
I've been searching for you all this time,
Orion.
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_222: No. You are Orion. My hope.
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_223:
Why me? There are lots of people
stronger than me, like Ms. Ais...
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_224:
Strength isn't what makes one worthy of
this spear. It's a pure, unsullied soul.
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_226:
Told you, it's a legendary spear! Even
Hephaistos vouches for it! It chose you, Bell!
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_227:
Chose me...?
The spear chose me...?
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_230:
Bring that white soul and come with me.
Orion.
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_240:
Artemis!
I'll take on that quest!!
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_242: Of course I'll help out a friend in need!
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_245:
Thank you, Hestia!!
Truly, thank you!
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_246:
Uh... B-besides, leaving you alone with Bell
would be way too dangerous.
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_247:
Then Lili's going too!
You'll pay us handsomely later, of course?
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_248: Well, we're already on board, so.
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_249:
Now then, Bell. All that's left is your
answer— but you've already made up your mind,
haven't you?
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_250: All right. I'll take on that quest.
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_252:
You aren't my familia. But from now on, you
are my traveling companions. Please, seal a
pact with me.
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_254: Bell, it's a kiss! A kiss!
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_267:
Well, now that that's settled, let's head
out!
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_269:
Well? What do you think of these custom
outfits, designed by yours truly, travel
specialist Hermes?!
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_270:
Only the finest materials! Light and
stretchy, of course, with rare metal woven in
for 30% more durability!
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_271:
They may be battle clothes, but they defend
as well as armor—and they never get in the
wearer's way!!
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_272:
Only I, Hermes, in all the vast heavens,
could put together such fine pieces in mere
hours—
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_273: That looks good on you, Bell!
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_274:
Thank you. It looks great on you too,
Goddess.
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_278: Mr. Welf, you're bringing a magic sword?
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_280:
But if we're leaving Orario,
why are we up on the city wall?
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_281:
Who knows?
Artemis, did you hear anything?
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_293:
Yep. I asked Ganesha ahead of time. Overland
it'd take a month, but on these, we'll be
there in 10 days.
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_294:
Besides, if I don't get back soon,
Asfi's going to chew me out.
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_295: Huh? What do you mean by—
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_299: Hey, aren't we short a few dragons?
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_300: Frankly, I couldn't round up enough!!
theater_main_quest_99_01_01_301: —And so, we'll be riding two to a dragon.
theater_main_quest_99_01_02_005:
It's dark, and so high up...
I thought maybe the dragon scared you.
theater_main_quest_99_01_02_007:
To be honest, my heart's kind of
pounding a little too—Ah!
theater_main_quest_99_01_02_008:
Your heart is beating faster.
Is this what you call "pounding"?
theater_main_quest_99_01_02_009:
Hey, Artemiiis!!
Bell is MY familia member!
theater_main_quest_99_01_02_015: Lord Hermes! So where are we headed, anyway?
theater_main_quest_99_01_02_017:
Far from Orario, at the edge of the
continent. The ruins of Elsos, hidden in the
great forest.
theater_main_quest_99_01_02_018:
Ah, what a nice breeze!
I could fly forever.
theater_main_quest_99_01_02_019: How can you be so laid-back?
theater_main_quest_99_01_02_020:
We've been flying for a week. I'm sick of
the view. Right, Bell?
theater_main_quest_99_01_02_027: What on earth is going on?
theater_main_quest_99_01_02_032: Not yet! Circle around like that!
theater_main_quest_99_01_02_038:
This is bad!!
Mr. Bell's gone!!
theater_main_quest_99_01_02_059: What the heck is that monster...?!
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_009: Lady Artemis! Are you all right...?!
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_012:
Phew... Please don't do anything so reckless,
Lady Artemis!
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_014:
Wha?! Oh, w-well, because... you're a girl!
My grandpa said it's a guy's job to protect
girls...! So!
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_018:
No one has ever said that to me before.
Heh... Believe it or not, I'm far stronger
than Hermes or Hestia.
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_023:
I know you're strong, but don't do
anything reckless!
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_024: Your child just told me the very same thing.
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_036:
Bell. It's dangerous, so try not
to use that spear too much.
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_037:
Oh, okay.
Lord Hermes, this spear—
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_038: Besides... I'd rather not be noticed.
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_043: Helping people is all well and good, but...
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_045:
What are we supposed to do now that
you've given away all our food?
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_046: All we've got left is bread.
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_047: I'm fine even if I don't eat.
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_048:
You might be, Lady Artemis!
But we're completely starving!
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_052:
What is with her?!
This goddess is hopeless!!
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_053: Hey, hey, she is a goddess, y'know.
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_054:
Hmph! Goddess or not, hopeless is hopeless!
She's the goddess of hopelessness! Honestly!
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_055: Fweh... How did she end up like this?
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_057:
Yeah. Scary dignified, a real heroine type.
Back in the heavens, just for peeking at her
bath—
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_058: Have you no shame?! You swine!
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_060: Ahh, those were the days, mm-hmm.
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_061:
Anyway! The sun's setting, so let's camp here
and set out tomorrow morning.
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_066: Oh! Maybe I can do something...
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_071:
I see, masala fruit! When heated, the flesh
melts into rich juice. A true forest
restaurant!
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_076:
Oh, before I came to Orario,
my grandpa taught me stuff like this.
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_095:
There are scorpion-type monsters,
but I've never seen one like that.
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_096:
They said it's been attacking nearby
villages.
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_097:
It all started when monsters were spotted
multiplying abnormally.
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_098:
Lots of familias were sent to find the cause,
but every one of them vanished.
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_099:
The place is the land of Elsos.
A seal had been placed on the ruins there.
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_101:
It rots hills, eats away at seas, kills
forests, and drains the strength of every
living thing.
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_102:
A monster sealed away in ancient times by
the Great Spirits: Antares.
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_104:
But over a long time, it quietly gathered
power deep below—and at last, it broke the
seal.
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_107:
Yep. Orario's taking this seriously,
so they sent my familia.
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_108:
There, I met Artemis, who'd come for the same
reason. And we returned to Orario to call for
backup.
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_109:
Wait a moment!
Then you should get a stronger familia!
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_111:
Only that spear can defeat Antares.
And the one the spear chose—
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_114:
As long as we have the spear, it'll all work
out! C'mon, let's get to bed for tomorrow!
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_120:
But to think you would have a familia,
Hestia.
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_124: What do you think of Orion?
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_126:
Wh-wh-wh-what do I think...?!
He's my adorable familia member!
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_127:
Well, more than that, actually... He's
like, essential to me, or, um... Ahem.
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_130:
I see... My heart pounds when I'm with him
too...
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_135: So you can't go feeling that way!
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_138:
You were against that kind of stuff,
weren't you, Artemis!
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_140:
Honestly! What happened to the old anti-
romance you?! ...Oh.
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_142:
Hey, Artemis.
Where's your familia right now?
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_143:
...They aren't here.
But they're waiting for me to return.
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_146:
Yeah. Gods aren't supposed to change,
but you have.
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_148: ...Phew. Things never go how you want, huh.
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_149:
Whaddaya mean?! We can't leave Orario?!
What's that supposed to mean?!
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_150:
Apparently it's the Guild's orders. We've
been strictly told to stay inside Orario.
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_153:
Whaaa?! What're those Guild folks thinkin'?!
Are they nuts?!
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_173: Ngh... Are you all right, Lady Artemis?!
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_184: What was that light just now...?!
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_185:
It was probably aimed at me... No.
At the spear he carries.
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_189: Are these the same as the one before?
theater_main_quest_99_01_03_190: No, they're a different size and shape!
theater_main_quest_99_01_04_008:
Mr. Cranel. I never expected to meet you
in a place like this.
theater_main_quest_99_01_04_009: What are you doing here, Ms. Ryu?
theater_main_quest_99_01_04_010:
I was asked to come along on a troublesome
quest. By them—
theater_main_quest_99_01_04_015:
You...! You numbskull!! Dumping the ruins'
surveillance on us and going home alone!!
theater_main_quest_99_01_04_016:
Whoa, whoa, calm down, Asfi...! I told you, I
went to find the spear's owner!!
theater_main_quest_99_01_04_017: Even so, don't just disappear on your own!!
theater_main_quest_99_01_04_022:
You're the one who pulled the spear? Frankly,
I was hoping for a somewhat stronger familia.
theater_main_quest_99_01_04_027:
The forest's corruption is spreading,
and the monsters are still multiplying.
theater_main_quest_99_01_04_028:
The nearby villages have already been wiped
out.
theater_main_quest_99_01_04_029: What about the assaults on the ruins?
theater_main_quest_99_01_04_030: Every one has failed—the gate blocks us.
theater_main_quest_99_01_04_033: Yes. Because of it, we can't reach Antares.
theater_main_quest_99_01_04_039: There's something I need to ask you.
theater_main_quest_99_01_04_044:
Two goddesses have a lot to catch up on.
Let's give them some time alone.
theater_main_quest_99_01_04_047:
That light earlier! What was that all about?!
Why would that...?!
theater_main_quest_99_01_04_048:
You're Artemis, all right. But you're not
Artemis.
theater_main_quest_99_01_04_050:
This area's still normal, but it'll be
corrupted soon. We're using it as a base for
our assaults.
theater_main_quest_99_01_04_051:
Are you tired from the long trip? There's
a spring up ahead where you can bathe.
theater_main_quest_99_01_04_052:
Really? That'd be wonderful! Lili's all
sticky with sweat.
theater_main_quest_99_01_04_055: The holy war is about to begin!
theater_main_quest_99_01_04_057:
Now listen up!
Beyond here lies a maidens' paradise!!
theater_main_quest_99_01_04_058:
Lili, Asfi, and the others are bathing in
nothing but their birthday suits...!
theater_main_quest_99_01_04_060:
And Artemis! No one has ever seen one of the
three great virgin goddesses without a stitch
on!
theater_main_quest_99_01_04_062:
My dream was crushed once. But my heart tells
me— "Don't give up!" And now!
theater_main_quest_99_01_04_063:
Now I have all of you!
Comrades who share my ambition!
theater_main_quest_99_01_04_065:
Before us stands the summit of hardship! But
when you conquer it, your names will live
forever!
theater_main_quest_99_01_04_066:
Rise up, young men!
Become true heroes!!
theater_main_quest_99_01_04_071:
Grant these proud warriors your blessing of
victory!
theater_main_quest_99_01_04_074: I figured it would be something like this.
theater_main_quest_99_01_04_080:
Go onnnn!!
Climb over our corpses! Seize victory!!
theater_main_quest_99_01_04_081:
Victory... Hm? Where are Lady Artemis
and Lady Hestia?!
theater_main_quest_99_01_04_083:
Huh?! Lady Hestia's already turned in,
and Lady Artemis... You know?
theater_main_quest_99_01_04_096:
You're lucky. The old me would have shot you
full of arrows on the spot.
theater_main_quest_99_01_04_097: Wha?! So what the Goddess said was true!
theater_main_quest_99_01_04_099:
